requirements.text: 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support
Prior experience at a managed service provider (MSP)
Background in providing direct end-user support
Advanced technical knowledge including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents
IT-related degree and/or certifications such as Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent
Provides mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians
Maintains and updates written client and process documentation
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
High level of attention to detail
Installs, configures, diagnoses, tests and resolves technical hardware and software issues
Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 email, calendar, voice and directory services

Daniel Okafor

Desk Technician, Pinecrest School District, 2016 to 2019
